## Checklist

- [ ] Tests first: new behavior and its edge cases are covered, and a bug has an `issue-<n>-<slug>` regression test.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes locally (CI cannot run it).
- [ ] A user-visible change has a line in `docs/releases/unreleased.md` (with `(#<n>)` and thanks to the reporter when it comes from an issue).
- [ ] The matching page in `docs/` is updated.
- [ ] New UI has an approved mockup.
